governance_note: The governed artifact of the one fixed READY / RUNNING control-cycle definition, under STAGE28_T4_CONTROL_CYCLE_READY_RUNNING_CONTRACT.md. It carries the method identity and semantic version, the fixed definition (two states, one Boolean input, one transition, one Boolean output map), the inventor's confirmations, the high-risk screen, the limitations, the fixed disclosure meaning and the source and source-use records. It is NOT a Domain Pack, NOT an entry in domains/domain_provenance.json and NOT a method of the shared deterministic calculation and units owner; it activates no domain, part or 28-T4 owner beyond this one evaluation. Nothing here is PLC, IEC 61131-3 or scan-cycle execution, a timing, electrical, I/O, compatibility or safety statement, a safety function or interlock, or a readiness, progression or validation input.

method.cycle_order: 1. freeze the one Boolean input start_input; 2. read the one previous state; 3. evaluate the one transition against the previous state and the frozen input; 4. select the next state (the transition's target when it applies and its condition holds, otherwise the previous state); 5. calculate the one Boolean output as output_map[next_state].
method.output_rule: The output is read from the NEXT state, never from the previous state. This is InventorAI's own design decision for this evaluation; it is not claimed to be how OpenPLC, any PLC or any IEC 61131-3 runtime executes a program.
method.no_transition_rule: When the previous state is not the transition's source, the transition is not applicable and the previous state is kept; when the previous state is the source and the condition is false, the transition does not fire and the previous state is kept. Both are routine results, never refusals.

declarations.accepted_value: the logic considered has exactly two states, READY and RUNNING, and the previous state entered is the one it was in before this cycle
its only transition goes from READY to RUNNING when start_input is true; there is no way back to READY and no other transition, timer, counter or fault state
the one Boolean output is false in READY and true in RUNNING, and it is read from the state after this cycle
start_input is the only input, its value is read once and held unchanged for the whole cycle, and nothing else (power-up, reset, other signals or the passage of time) is considered
the states, the input and the output are logical values only; whether any real device, signal or piece of equipment is switched, started, stopped or energized is not decided here

screen_items.item: a safety function, interlock, emergency stop or protective shut-off
moving machinery or parts that could injure someone

limitations: One evaluation of one fixed definition only: no custom states, transitions, conditions, timers, counters, sequences, interlocks or output maps; no client-supplied expression, callback or transition table is accepted, and an attempt to supply one is refused.

No PLC, IEC 61131-3, ladder, function-block or scan-cycle execution; no timing, scan time, determinism guarantee, I/O, electrical, wiring, controller or vendor statement; no safety function, SIL / PL or interlock.
No state is stored or carried between evaluations; InventorAI does not track, infer or read the state of the inventor's system, components, signals or process.
All NO answers on the high-risk screen only allow this bounded evaluation to proceed; they never mean safe. The screen neither reads nor feeds SafetySignal.
The result is UNVALIDATED and is not evidence; it is request-local and is not stored, reported, exported or used for readiness, progression or validation.
disclosure: This is one evaluation of the fixed READY / RUNNING logic you confirmed, for the previous state and the start_input value you entered: start_input is read once and held, the one transition is checked, the next state is chosen and the output is read from the next state.
If the transition does not apply, the state stays as it was; that is a normal result, not an error.
The output is a logical value (true or false) only. It does not mean that any real device is switched, started, stopped or energized, and nothing is sent to any device.
Nothing is stored between evaluations: each one starts from the previous state you enter, and InventorAI does not track the state of your system.

Reading the output from the next state is InventorAI's own design choice for this evaluation. It is not a claim about how any PLC, OpenPLC or IEC 61131-3 runtime executes a program, and no timing, scan time or electrical behaviour is implied.
It is not a safety function, interlock or emergency stop. It is preliminary, advisory, UNVALIDATED and not evidence, and any real control logic must be designed and checked by a qualified engineer.
